author: Masch@

title: Over promising under delivering
body:
The app makes it look like it works only when you pay, but you can skip 3 attempts to scam you using the X button at the lest. You will quickly learn that they tried to scam you because on the first onboarding screen they show you full price, then when you skip they show you that you got 50% off for only ~2 minutes and then it will expire, you skip that one too and then the app opens and you see a banner showing you 50% off same offer but for 24 hours!
The only difference between paid and not paid is the ads on the articles that they offer (which is general knowledge you can find anywhere on the internet).
The habits they have are very generic, you cannot modify them or even understand how they work.
All of this and i still wanted to give it a try, so i set up few so-called-challenges-of-theirs and some personal tasks and some personal habits, thinking that they will encourage me to do more of them; so first of all my tasks disappeared and no where to be seen in the app!
Second, they send you one notification at the end of the day summarizing how much you accomplish funny enough it says you did 0 out of 0 while i had something in there.

I think the app is terribly designed, it doesn’t work properly and it doesn’t do the only thing you’d download it for; encouraging you to improve you habits!

In one word: scam!

They take the “lifetime access” payment and give you crap!
author: Antoon91

title: Scam app.
body: I foolishly signed up have been conned into paying twice. After selecting an option I was presented with a 50% off for the option I was looking at. I can now see that I’ve paid twice for the same thing, full price and half price. I can’t now find a way to request a refund.
